purpose: Research-only timing grade per river. Not read by the app; catalog speeds unchanged. Source data: research/trip-times/WA.json.

grades.sourced: dated trip report or agency guide with time+distance on a catalog section
grades.loosely-supported: off-section, undated, outfitter, no-flow or low-confidence only

recommendations.defer: hide time until a real trip is logged

range.basis: NPS Hanford Reach guide: 4-6 h at 'moderate' 80,000-120,000 cfs; dated notes 4.5 h at 111 kcfs (no lunch)

columbia-hanford.note: Agency guide plus 4 trip logs; ref 4.0 mph at 101 kcfs (4.75 h) sits inside the NPS range. Wind is the main variable.

range.basis: outfitter 'average 2 hours', KATU 1-2 h, AW report 2 h (7.5 mi, 5,090 cfs daily mean)

cowlitz.note: Ref 4.0 mph at 3,000 cfs = ~1.9 h, consistent with all sources.

range.basis: 'Float Time Estimates on the Wallowa and Grande Ronde' speed table (Troy gauge); author unconfirmed

grande-ronde-lower.note: Undated speed table only; low confidence.

grande-ronde-troy.note: Mountaineers report is off-section; speed table undated.

green-flaming-geyser.note: One AW report (3 h, distance not stated, 1,530 cfs) - nowhere near the 340 cfs ref flow; no supported range.

green-gorge.note: One dated AW report on kanaskat-flaming-geyser: 3 h for 12 mi at ~1,250 cfs (4.0 mph). Single observation at a higher flow than the 780 cfs ref, so no range is claimed.

klickitat.note: Dated AW report icehouse-turkey-hole: 2 h for 10.9 mi at ~2,300 cfs (5.45 mph). Leidl-Icehouse report is low-confidence (lower bound only). No source-stated range.

range.basis: two AW reports: averill-pateros 17 mi in 2.5 h at 6,500 cfs; Averill-Burma Rd 8.4 mi in 75 min at 4,310 cfs

methow-lower.note: Both observations are at 2.4-3.6x the 1,800 cfs ref flow; the range applies to high water only. Ref 4.5 mph at 1,800 cfs is not directly supported.

sauk.note: One AW report (Darrington to ~Sauk, 23 mi in 6 h incl. lunch at ~8,500 cfs) covers more than the catalog sections; a second has no distance.

skagit-eagle.note: Dated blog trip log on marblemount-howard-miller: 115 min for 10.5 mi at ~9,700 cfs (5.5 mph, mostly drifting). Higher than the 3,900 cfs ref flow; single non-agency source.

range.basis: Triad River Tours trip summary: 120-150 min Goodell-Copper (dam-regulated, May-Sep)

skagit-upper.note: Outfitter guided-raft time; no flow stated.

skykomish.note: One AW report partly off-section (2.86 mph at 2,950 cfs, paddling most of the time).

snoqualmie-mf.note: concrete-bridge-tanner 7 mi in 2 h but reporter flow (~5,000 cfs) conflicts with the gauge (2,070); other reports are slow wildlife surveys with no distance.

wenatchee-leavenworth.note: Only an outfitter tubing time on a 2-mile sub-reach at low summer flow (~1.3 mph); not representative of boats on the 5.2 mi section.

wenatchee-upper.note: Dated AW report lake-wenatchee-plain: 2 h for 7.4 mi at 2,600 cfs (3.7 mph). Ref 2.5 mph is at 780 cfs, so the observation does not test the ref directly.

white-salmon.note: Only an outfitter full-day figure (~4 mph gross over a longer reach); nothing on the 4.4 mi bz-husum section.

range.basis: Yakima River Tubing: 'Float time: 3hrs - 4 hours' Umtanum-Roza (tubes)

yakima-canyon.note: Outfitter tubing range; boats are likely faster. No flow stated.
